entries.title: Competing Platform exclusivity in India and GCC
entries.summary: AtliQ and its Affiliates may not act as an implementation, reseller, or referral partner for any cloud data-warehouse, lakehouse, or unified analytics platform offered as a service in India or the GCC countries during the term of the agreement.
entries.quote: during the Term Partner and its Affiliates shall not act as an implementation, reseller or referral partner for any Competing Platform in India or the GCC.

relatedClauses.quote: "Affiliate" means, in relation to a Party, any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with that Party, where "control" means ownership of more than fifty per cent (50%) of the voting securities or the power to direct management.

"Territory" means the Republic of India and the member states of the Gulf Cooperation Council, being the United Arab Emirates, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, the State of Qatar, the State of Kuwait, the Kingdom of Bahrain and the Sultanate of Oman.
"Competing Platform" means any cloud data-warehouse, lakehouse or unified analytics platform offered as a service.

For clarity, Clause 7.1 does not restrict Partner or its Affiliates from (a) providing services outside India and the GCC; or (b) providing services to a customer that has independently selected a platform, provided Partner does not hold a partner appointment with, or receive any fee or benefit from, the provider of that platform.
In this Clause 7, "GCC" has the meaning given to the member states listed in the definition of Territory.

entries.notes: AtliQ and its Affiliates are prohibited from acting as a partner for competing cloud data platforms in India and the GCC. Standard carve-outs exist under Clause 7.3 for services where a customer independently selects a platform, provided AtliQ holds no partner appointment or fee from that platform provider.

entries.title: Staff non-solicitation
entries.summary: During the term of the agreement and for six months thereafter, neither party shall actively solicit for employment any employee of the other party with whom they had material contact under the agreement.
entries.quote: During the Term and for six (6) months thereafter, neither Party shall actively solicit for employment any employee of the other Party with whom it had material contact under this Agreement. General advertisements are not solicitation.
entries.notes: Routine mutual staff non-solicit with material-contact qualification and six-month post-term tail.

entries.title: Minimum Certified Engineers requirement
entries.summary: AtliQ must maintain at least four (4) Certified Engineers (employees holding a current CloudSpan Certified Implementation Engineer credential) throughout the term of the agreement.
entries.quote: Partner shall maintain, throughout the Term, not fewer than four (4) Certified Engineers. Where the number falls below four (4) for reasons outside Partner's reasonable control, Partner shall have ninety (90) days to restore it.

relatedClauses.quote: "Certified Engineer" means an employee of Partner who holds a current CloudSpan Certified Implementation Engineer credential.

entries.notes: AtliQ has a 90-day grace period to restore the engineer count to four if the drop was outside its reasonable control.
